intro: Gabon is a rainforest country on the equator, ruled by one family for over 50 years until a coup in 2023.

chapters.title: Early peoples
text: Forest peoples have lived here for tens of thousands of years. Bantu-speaking Fang, Punu and other peoples later settled. Lopé has ancient rock carvings.

chapters.title: French rule
text: French explorers and missionaries arrived in the 1800s; Libreville was founded for freed enslaved people in 1849. Albert Schweitzer ran a famous hospital at Lambaréné from 1913.

chapters.title: Independence and the Bongos
text: Gabon became independent in 1960. Omar Bongo ruled from 1967 to 2009, and his son Ali Bongo until a coup in 2023. Coup leader Brice Oligui Nguema won a presidential election in 2025.
